metrics.assumptions: Repeat each observed waypoint/asset/action combination using the latest observed configuration and its last observed hour. No future mission plan is available.
metrics.validation_note: Last 20% of missions held out. History updates with earlier completed holdout missions, without refitting. Final forecast model refit on all eligible actions.
limitations: Synthetic challenge data; inspection action failure is not equipment failure.
Small chronological holdout; scores are not calibrated real-world probabilities.
Coefficient associations do not establish why an incident happened.
Historical waypoint rate pools configurations and action types; each forecast is a specific candidate.
